about: Every setting and word a page can put on the sign-up card, each as data-hub-signup-<name> on the card. Held to lib/hub.js by ci/check_signup_settings.py. A setting marked wide has a twin, <name>-wide, read from 60rem; without the twin the setting holds at every width. A word may carry only its own {tokens}; a list word takes exactly that many entries, ';'-separated, in the default's order. A setting marked model false is for the library's own tests and never goes on a page.

intent.about: The brand's interest labels for the first choice step, ';'-separated, spelled as its join flow spells them. Empty or absent leaves the step out.

enjoy.about: The brand's interest labels for the second choice step, up to six picked. Empty or absent leaves the step out.

seeking.about: Whether 'looking for' starts ticked from the 'I am' answer: opposite, or same for a brand whose members meet their own sex. The visitor's own tick wins.

dob.about: The date of birth as three boxes to type in, or three scroll wheels.

dob-start.about: Where the year wheel opens: blank, or an age, the year that many years ago. Day and month always open blank, and the boxes always open empty.

reward.about: What a complete date of birth shows: the age and star sign, the age alone, or nothing.

settle.about: off stops a phone scrolling the card up at each step.

guid.about: The site GUID for the members row, where the join link carries none.

places.about: Where the page's visitors are, in the platform's own location names: world, Country, Country/Region or Country/Region/Town. Absent: no location step.

places-from.about: Where the places files are, for the library's own tests.

postal.about: Where the join flow reads postal codes (the USA): the code first, the lists first, or the lists only.

screens.about: The order and grouping of the questions: screens split by '|', steps by spaces ('iam seeking | dob | email'), asked in the order written. A step left out is not asked, and the join flow asks it. Ignored whole unless every step is known and named once and email is in the last screen. On a card with its own order the members wait for 'looking for' to be answered, wherever it is asked. Absent: today's grouping.

members-from.about: When the members row shows: from the start, once a named step is answered (a step no screen asks counts as answered, and 'looking for' ticked from 'I am' by seeking counts too), or never. Absent on a card with its own screens, the row waits for 'looking for'.

members-caption.about: off shows the members' faces without the line beside them.

messages.about: The line after an answer: on, off, or the moments that speak, space-separated ('iam last'); a moment left out says nothing.

messages-keep.about: How long a line stays: until the next answer, or for the step it leads into and no longer.

messages-from.about: Where the message files are, for the library's own tests.

platform.about: Whose interest lines the card may use. The toolkit fills it from the brand.

say-iam.about: The page's own lines after 'I am', ';'-separated.

say-seeking.about: The page's own lines after 'looking for', ';'-separated; {who} plays the answer back.

say-location.about: The page's own lines once a place is given, ';'-separated; {place} is the town or region.

say-interest.about: The page's own lines after any interest is ticked, ';'-separated; {interest} is its label.

say-last.about: The page's own lines on reaching the last step, ';'-separated.

say-labels.about: The page's own lines for one interest: 'Label: line | line; Label: line'.

say-mode.about: add mixes the page's lines with the library's; replace uses only the page's, where it has some.

back.about: The back arrow's spoken name; the arrow itself has no words.

seeking-help.default: Pick as many as you like.

tally-full.default: {n} of {max}, the most you can pick.

error-date.default: Add your full date of birth.

error-age.default: You need to be 18 or over to join.

error-details.default: Add your first name and email, and tick the box.

going.default: Taking you on to finish signing up

location-help.default: So we can match you with people nearby.

town-hint.default: Type your town, or scroll the list

zip-to-lists.default: Or choose your state and town

zip-to-code.default: Or enter your ZIP code instead

error-zip.default: Enter your 5-digit ZIP code, or choose your state and town.

zip-unknown.default: We don't know that ZIP code. Check it, or choose your state and town.

places-more.default: Keep typing to find the rest

places-none.default: No town by that name. Check the spelling.
